protocol: Agents must read this sidecar BEFORE consulting docs/07-api-reference.json or quoting endpoint contracts. If (now - lastFetchedAt) >= stalenessThresholdHours, run fetchCommand — it backs up the current spec to previousPath, fetches the new spec, writes a shape-level diff to changesPath, and updates lastFetchedAt + lastFetchedAtDisplay in this file. Agents do not hand-edit those fields. Inside the 6h window, trust the local copy and skip the refresh. See docs/10-frontend-api-usage.md §Freshness protocol.
